options: getRowCount() is deprecated and no longer works in current ServiceNow releases
getRowCount() counts every matching row before checking anything, while hasNext() stops at the first match — a real performance difference at scale
hasNext() returns a boolean while getRowCount() throws an error
There is no actual difference; the review flagged it for style reasons only

questions.q: Why must the equipment-availability Business Rule run before insert rather than after?
options: After Business Rules run faster than before Business Rules
Before and after Business Rules behave identically for this purpose

setAbortAction(true) only works on update operations, never insert
questions.explain: setAbortAction(true) must be called before the database write happens — that's only possible from a before Business Rule.

What does adding this condition script to the Business Rule actually accomplish, beyond scoping it to insert alone?

current.equipment.nil() == false

questions.q: Why can Isolate Script safely stay checked on the capstone's Client Script, per this lesson's review?
